NOT MOUNTED this lane: games_played is derived from a 500-bet pull, so labelling it 'Total bets' would overstate a heavy player's count, and GameDetailPage was being edited by peers today.

play: n=1 (10183-270971). ***RECLASSIFIED AS A DECLINE, NOT BACKLOG, ON NEW EVIDENCE.*** I read the frame subtree: the overlay modal is 10183:271827, 564x658, and its two strings are 'Sorry, skai.trade is unsupported in your region, but you can try skai.jp right now.' and 'Our licences do not currently cover your region/country, but you can still get live on the action at skai.jp.', with ONE full-width 516 CTA (the 254 variant is hidden). THREE findings. (1) skai.jp EXISTS NOWHERE - zero hits across src/ and supabase/, and the only two hits in modules/ are the catalog itself and a DEFERRED constant. Shipping it would send a geo-blocked user to a domain the codebase has no record of owning. (2) The copy makes a per-region LICENCE claim, which is the same fail-closed class as the GCB/GambleAware marks Casey PARKED on 2026-08-25. (3) It is the THIRD drawing of one modal - 10012:192546 (built), 9220:26119 (already declined in scratchersPageContent.ts:394-418 as SCRATCHERS_REGION_MODAL_DEFERRED, on the grounds that a second competing region modal would give the app two), and this one. The catalog's existing note about the 'variant' references being the verification-failure Retry state is accurate and unchanged.
